item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Enrique Iglesias , live DVD video from concert
item.description:
Hi, I am after Enrique Iglesias's live video recordings from concerts or live tv performance, etc. There are some videos on yt but I am after professional quality video with clean audio track. These are extremely hard to find. The format does not matter- dvd, vob or just mp4 as long as it is good quality. Five channels audio would be nice.
Some examples here:
https://www.discogs.com/release/11394985-Enrique-Iglesias-Live-From-Odyssey-Arena-Belfast
Songs that I am most interested in: Subeme la radio, Hero, Tired of being sorry (including the version with Nadiya), Bailando, Bailamos, El Perdón (with Enrique Iglesias), I am tacking back my love....
